title: Auditing Connectivity Claims in Tubular Structure Segmentation: Code, Evaluation Artifacts, and Audit Scorecards
mechanism: Audits published connectivity claims with two-annotator adjudication, 44 per-paper scorecards, 325 multi-seed evaluation files and a loss-regime interaction study.
adaptation: Benchmark design only. It is a template for auditing published EL numbers (seeds, provenance, annotator agreement) and matches our two-annotator IoU of 0.21 to 0.26.
min_experiment: No training. Adapt its scorecard rubric to 10 published EL segmentation papers and report how many claims survive a multi-seed, leakage-free protocol.
evidence: R: artifact description only (325 multi-seed JSON files, 240-segment two-annotator adjudication).
